title: GEO Dataset Discovery
description: Discover bounded NCBI GEO Series with exact query provenance, study metadata, sample counts, public links, and analysis-readiness caveats.

tools.name: geo_dataset_preview
tools.description: Preview up to eight NCBI GEO Series in source relevance order, preserving the exact GSE-only query, organism, assay, sample-count filter, accessions, study metadata, and public links.

query.description: Disease, tissue, phenotype, perturbation, or fielded GEO query.

organism.description: Exact organism scientific name, or blank for any organism.

tools.name: geo_dataset_collect
tools.description: Collect and persist an approved NCBI GEO Series discovery with up to 20 source-ordered records, sample examples, exact filters, report, manifest, and interpretation limits.
